name: Vueway
indications_original:
Vueway® is indicated in adult and pediatric patients
aged 2 years and older for use with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
to detect and visualize lesions with abnormal vascularity in:
                  
                     the central nervous system (brain, spine, and associated
tissues),
                     the body (head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal
system).
contraindications_original: The recommended dose for adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older is 0.05 mmol/kg actual body weight (equivalent to 0.1 mL/kg) administered intravenously at approximately 2 mL/sec. ( 2 )
